text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's wrap things up for today—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm falling behind the other girls when 
accelerating out of the corners...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping you could show me how you 
run, Senpai.
choice_data_list:

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, flattery will get you nowhere.

text_block_list.text:
Running together might be better than 
words. Do you mind if I stay behind a bit 
to watch her...?

Yes. Analyzing the challenges each 
individual requires, devising 
countermeasures, and showing them the 
way...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It is a fine opportunity to gain such 
experience for the day I become a coach 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If you're going to become an 
instructor in the future, that skill will 
likely be needed far more often.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If you notice any shortcomings while 
listening nearby, please do give us your 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided not to push her physically, 
opting instead to have her gain experience 
by putting her training knowledge into 
words.
